ideas.pitch: An automated engineering team lifecycle intelligence platform that indexes code repositories, PRs, and Slack conversations to capture tribal knowledge before team members depart.
ideas.title: DevKnowledge Capture Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting engineering team knowledge retention directly addresses a pain point experienced by technical judges and university student dev clubs, similar to devflow's success.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router that classifies student queries and routes them to the correct academic, administrative, or hostel management micro-service without hitting slow backend databases.
ideas.title: Semantic Multi-Source Router for Campus Portals
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a lightweight kNN exemplar index and LLM-judge writeback to optimize query performance, following the architecture of darwin-router.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered VS Code extension that provides inline code auto-completion, autonomous bug identification, GUI-based fix application, and automated test generation for students.
ideas.title: VS Code AI Assistant and Automated Testing Extension
ideas.why_it_could_win: Developer-tool extensions are immediately relatable to hackathon judges who write code daily, directly matching codeboost's proven strategy.

ideas.pitch: A zero-configuration RAG toolkit optimized for relational databases that automatically chunks, embeds, and indexes college circulars, notices, and syllabi for instant conversational retrieval.
ideas.title: Auto-Embedding & RAG Toolkit for Campus Documentation
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an acute operational headache for academic institutions like NIT Agartala, aligning with the practical database-centric design of seamless-rag.

ideas.pitch: A mobile application integrated with local campus infrastructure to automate IT support ticket triage, auto-approval workflows, and equipment repair requests without requiring enterprise SaaS fees.
ideas.title: Autonomous IT Service Desk Mobile Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings the autonomous agent ticket-to-execution workflow proven in copilot-studio-itsm-agent directly to a mobile-first student interface.
